d: Antriksh ke zariye milne vali sevaen hamari rozmarra ki zindgi ke lie behad zaruri ho gaee hain. jipies, saitelait intarnet aur orbit se hone vala kamyunikeshan. nagrik istemal ke alava, spes sistam ab sainy takrav men bhi aham bhumika nibha rahe hain, jisse antriksh men dabadba banane ki hor tez ho rahi hai.
